title.zh: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions

current_state.zh: OpenAI published a 67-page paper claiming its AI found a way around the 1999 Exponential Time Hypothesis, prompting both scientific scrutiny and confused reactions from crypto traders who mistook 'ETH' for Ethereum.
